title: Build git-publication native fixture repositories from explicit MakeMe data

intentCoverage.report:
## Dough Intent Coverage: Assertion gap

**Story and revision:** SEED-262#migrate-git-publication-native-fixtures (.planning/seeds/SEED-262-faster-dashboard-test-feedback.md), plan 534, completed revision 15779d8267371aee864e4eafd307f870d9a68735.

**Promise:** "Each affected evidence identity covers the repository inputs that its fixture uses" (Scope, with plan 534 slice 1 requiring the installer inputs). Observable behavior: every Git publication family identity (startup, admission, one-shot, owned-context) carries an `input-hash:` line for each installer helper a fresh `install.sh --source` run sources, so editing that helper changes the identity.

**Fault (one change):** in `tests/support/git-publication-native-fixture-identity.sh`, `git_publication_installer_input_hash_lines`, deleted the single list line `src/install/open-dough-platform.sh \`. That helper is sourced on every fresh install: `install.sh:325` sources `open-dough-install-entry.sh`, which sources `open-dough-install-payload.sh`, which sources `open-dough-platform.sh` at line 10.

**Fixture and maintained assertions:** `tests/git-publication-fixture-identity.sh` (the selected check) builds each family identity from a scratch copy. It asserts that each family lists `installer_inputs`. That list names `install.sh`, `VERSION`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `open-dough-install-payload.sh`, `open-dough-register-hooks-merge.mjs`, and two payload files. It also checks sensitivity for `open-dough-register-hooks-merge.mjs` and `claude-hooks.json`, and checks that removed inputs fail. `tests/native-evidence-identity.sh` was run alongside as the related all-writer check. It names no `src/install/` input.

**Runs** (scratch worktree at the revision, `npm ci`, the given runner, `OPEN_DOUGH_TEST_TIMES` for reach; load averages about 15 to 21):
- Baseline: exit 0. Times file shows both jobs ran: git-publication-fixture-identity 7.3 s, native-evidence-identity 11.5 s. The direct identity probe showed that each family listed `open-dough-platform.sh` once (startup 382 rows, admission 388, one-shot 400, owned-context 390).
- Fault: exit 0. Both jobs ran (6.8 s and 11.0 s). Independent behavior evidence on the same writer path: a probe that sourced `tests/support/git-publication-native-run.sh` and called `git_publication_write_evidence_identity <family>` showed every family one row short (381/387/399/389) with zero `open-dough-platform.sh` rows. After a comment was appended to `src/install/open-dough-platform.sh`, the startup identity stayed byte-identical (`cmp` equal). The identity therefore looks complete and current while a fresh-install input changed. Both assertion sets ran and passed. They check only the sampled installer inputs, not the full set of helpers a fresh install sources.
- Restored: an EXIT trap restored the file, and `open-dough-platform.sh` was copied back (`cmp` equal). `git status --porcelain` was empty, matching the clean pre-probe state. The same command exited 0, and both jobs ran (6.9 s, 11.2 s). The scratch worktree was then removed with `git worktree remove` and `git worktree prune`. The execution checkout was not written. Its current uncommitted planning changes and HEAD f40a29409 belong to the concurrent wrap-up.

**Finding:** The hand-written installer list can lose a sourced `src/install/*.sh` helper with no test failing. Any of the eight shell helpers outside the asserted sample is exposed the same way: entry, request, platform, register-hooks.sh, release, release-version, release-resolve, release-baseline, release-leftovers and release-apply. For now, `open-dough-install-payload.sh` is the only asserted one. The planned correction SEED-262#guard-native-fixture-identity-inputs (plan 542) targets this drift. A check that derives the expected set from what a fresh install actually sources would catch it.

### Costs
- **Test runtime:** measured, from the runner's per-job times file (wall seconds per job under the stated load). Baseline 7.3 s + 11.5 s, fault 6.8 s + 11.0 s, restored 6.9 s + 11.2 s, about 54.7 s total. One earlier baseline run without a times file was unmeasured (exit 0, quiet). `npm ci` and the direct identity probes are not included.
- **Human effort:** unavailable. No human took part in this check, and no separate measure exists.
- **Agent effort:** unavailable. No separately supported token or tool-time measure is exposed to this agent.
- **Invocation-to-report elapsed:** see the finisher output above (measured from invocation start 1794155185198 ms).
